pay_detail: $15.00 per hour, up to 20 hours a week
name: University of Illinois Summer Youth Employment Program (SYEP)
org: Office of the Chancellor and Illinois Human Resources, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
what_you_do: Local high school students work in a campus department on projects, office support, research or event prep. They also attend about 2 to 3 hours of job skills sessions, usually on Fridays.
who_can_apply: Local high school students (the page does not give exact ages or the list of schools). Placements depend on student interest and the number of campus openings.
deadline_text: The 2026 program was set for June 15 to Aug 7, 2026 (tentative). No 2027 dates are posted yet. Departments are encouraged to express interest early.
how_to_apply: The page is written for campus departments that host a student. It does not say how a teen applies. Contact Tori Exum at texum@uillinois.edu (the team listing shows texum@illinois.edu, so check which is current), or the IHR general line at 217-333-2137.
notes: The university runs a background check for students under 18. Illinois work permit rules for workers under 18 were not checked.
